title: DL Workshop Pre-Training Assessment
description: Diagnostic assessment to gauge participant baseline knowledge of Differentiated Learning principles, pedagogical grouping, and formative assessment prior to the workshop.

questions.questionText: What is the primary objective of Differentiated Learning (DL) in basic school classrooms?
options: Giving the exact same worksheets to all students simultaneously
Adapting instruction, content, and pacing to match diverse learner needs
Separating high performers into private study halls only
Teaching solely through teacher-centered lectures
questions.correctAnswer: Adapting instruction, content, and pacing to match diverse learner needs

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of differentiating the 'Process' in a literacy or numeracy lesson?
options: Giving different end-of-term examination certificates
Providing tiered activities and varied instructional supports like manipulatives or graphic organizers
Charging varied fees for textbooks
Changing the classroom wall paint color
questions.correctAnswer: Providing tiered activities and varied instructional supports like manipulatives or graphic organizers

questions.questionText: Formative assessment in Differentiated Learning is used exclusively for assigning final grades at the end of the term.
options: True
False

questions.questionText: In the DL Dashboard and digital tracking system, what is the role of the IT Master Trainer?
options: Fix electrical wiring in the entire municipal assembly
Oversee digital attendance, school data reporting, and guide teachers on portal navigation
Distribute physical stationery supplies only
Conduct physical sports competitions
questions.correctAnswer: Oversee digital attendance, school data reporting, and guide teachers on portal navigation

questions.questionText: Flexible grouping allows learners to move between groups based on ongoing assessment and skill readiness rather than static labeling.
options: True
False

title: DL Workshop Post-Training Evaluation
description: Summative assessment to measure participant knowledge gains, mastery of DL methodologies, and readiness to cascade training to teachers in their respective districts.

questions.questionText: Which three classroom elements can teachers differentiate according to learner readiness, interests, and learning profiles?
options: Content, Process, and Product
Uniforms, Desks, and Bell timings
Chalk color, Blackboard height, and Room layout only
School fees, Lunch menu, and Holidays

questions.questionText: When assessing foundational literacy (reading levels), what is the most effective immediate intervention in a differentiated classroom?
options: Targeted small-group guided reading matched to specific phonics and comprehension stages
Suspending non-reading students from school
Reading aloud only to the highest performing students
Eliminating books from the classroom
questions.correctAnswer: Targeted small-group guided reading matched to specific phonics and comprehension stages

questions.questionText: Differentiated Learning means writing an entirely separate, individual lesson plan for each of the 50 students in a class.
options: True
False

questions.questionText: How should Master Trainers measure the success of DL cascading in their districts?
options: By counting physical attendance and tracking learner progress via the DL Dashboard
By giving up on monitoring once the 3-day workshop ends
By testing only the headteachers
By ignoring classroom observation metrics
questions.correctAnswer: By counting physical attendance and tracking learner progress via the DL Dashboard

questions.questionText: Which mindset is essential for a Master Trainer facilitating Differentiated Learning sessions?
options: Growth mindset that believes every child can learn with appropriate instructional scaffolding
Fixed mindset that only naturally gifted students can achieve numeracy proficiency
Belief that one standard pace fits all learners
Focus on rote memorization without conceptual understanding
questions.correctAnswer: Growth mindset that believes every child can learn with appropriate instructional scaffolding
